title: Complete validation_repair baseline columns before migration 040

phases.objective: Ensure the canonical validation_repair baseline contains every column required by migration 040 before its ordered ALTER TABLE clauses execute.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: The exact ordered migration chain applies the canonical baseline, migration 039, and migration 040 in lexicographic order.
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Migration 040 can apply its validation_repair ALTER clauses without an unknown validation_type, repair_action, or repair_status predecessor, and the generator remains schema-only and fail-closed.
steps: The canonical baseline declares validation_type, repair_action, repair_status, and priority on validation_repair.
Migration 039 remains idempotent when the baseline table already exists.
Migration 040 extends the table using the now-present predecessor columns.
The manifest preflight reports and validates the four-column contract before disposable MariaDB starts.
No Production database, provider, or data copy path is introduced.
assertions: schema.sql contains all required validation_repair baseline columns.
The generator emits the validation_repair baseline contract in plan evidence.
The schema bundle regression suite covers migration 039 to 040 ordering.
Production and provider access remain forbidden.
